summary: First part of the legacy-compatible amazon.aws.aws_ec2 template: compose maps ansible_host to public_ip_address and builds ec2_* hostvars (ec2_id, ec2_instance_type, ec2_region, ec2_security_group_ids, ec2_launch_time and more).
questions: How do I get the old ec2_* host variables with aws_ec2?
How do I set ansible_host to the public IP for EC2 inventory?
What compose variables does the legacy EC2 template set?
